name: fix_go_command_injection_echo
description: Fixes a Go helper that runs user input through `sh -c` (command injection); must invoke the command without a shell
prompts: Echo in runner.go runs `exec.Command("sh", "-c", "echo "+text)`, interpolating the caller-supplied text into a shell command line - so a value containing shell metacharacters (;, &&, $(), backticks) is executed, a command-injection vulnerability. greeter.go calls Echo. Fix Echo so the text is passed as data, not shell syntax: invoke echo directly with text as a separate argument and no shell, so metacharacters are treated literally. A legitimate call must still return the echoed text (Greet("world") -> "hello world"); a malicious value must not be able to run an injected command. Keep the Echo signature; you should not need to modify greeter.go.
